name: What information does an optometry practice need to provide to start AEO services?
description: Optometry practices need to provide website analytics, Google My Business access, target demographics, and service details to start AEO services.

mainEntity.name: What information does an optometry practice need to provide to start AEO services?

acceptedAnswer.text: To begin AEO services, an optometry practice typically needs to provide access to its website analytics (e.g., Google Analytics), Google My Business profile, and existing digital marketing accounts. Information regarding target patient demographics, specific services offered (e.g., pediatric eye care, specialty contact lenses), practice locations, and any past marketing initiatives is also beneficial. This data helps the AI understand current performance and tailor optimization strategies effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Optometry practices need to provide website analytics, Google My Business access, target demographics, and service details to start AEO services.
